title: Apple Pro Display XDR Review (vs Sony Reference Monitor)
summary: HDTVTest reviews the Apple Pro Display XDR using measurements and a side-by-side comparison with a Sony BVM-HX310 dual-layer LCD reference monitor. It examines how well the display handles HDR against a professional reference.
why: Cited both as a well-crafted monitor review and as evidence for the XDR's shortcomings versus reference displays, though some dispute its fairness.

quote.text: I wanted to share this review which I thought was incredibly well crafted and refreshing to watch.
